notes: Single-stage: reassemble a numeric recipe scattered across an env-style seed file, an inclusive date cutoff, and a journal of keyed operation entries; wrong arithmetic or wrong filtering yields a wrong payload. Generalization is probed by hidden clue sets (all-entries-filtered, malformed/junk files, missing seed/cutoff, numeric filename ordering, large and negative xor operands).
